passage.text: We meet once a week and take photos around the city.
passage.reading: wiː ˈmiːt ˈwʌns ə ˈwiːk ənd ˈteɪk ˈfoʊtoʊz əˈraʊnd ðə ˈsɪti.

passage.text: Beginners are welcome, and you don't need an expensive camera.
passage.reading: bɪˈɡɪnərz ər ˈwɛlkəm, ənd juː ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd ən ɪkˈspɛnsɪv ˈkæmərə.

passage.text: We practice three times a week, and once a month, we play music in the cafeteria.
passage.reading: wiː ˈpræktɪs ˈθriː ˈtaɪmz ə ˈwiːk, ənd ˈwʌns ə ˈmʌnθ, wiː ˈpleɪ ˈmjuːzɪk ɪn ðə ˌkæfəˈtɪriə.

passage.text: Come to our weekly game night on Wednesday evenings!
passage.reading: ˈkʌm tə aʊər ˈwiːkli ˈɡeɪm ˈnaɪt ɑːn ˈwɛnzdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋz!

passage.text: We play chess and many different games, and we can teach beginners.
passage.reading: wiː ˈpleɪ ˈtʃɛs ənd ˈmɛni ˈdɪfərənt ˈɡeɪmz, ənd wiː kən ˈtiːtʃ bɪˈɡɪnərz.
